steps.en: Review provenance and expose only the selected audit skill to your host
steps.zh: 核来源后只向宿主提供选定的审计技能

steps.en: Request an audit of a bounded change with its original spec and reports
steps.zh: 给出限定改动及原始规格、报告，请求审计

steps.en: Trace decisions made where the spec was silent
steps.zh: 追溯规格留白处由 agent 作出的选择

steps.en: Write gap, reach, verdict and confidence into a standalone choices ledger
steps.zh: 把留白、影响、裁决和信心写入独立选择账本

steps.en: Review the least-confident choices first; separately authorize any implementation
steps.zh: 先审低信心选择；另行授权后续实现

value.en: Review what the agent decided on your behalf, rather than infer it from a large diff
value.zh: 直接审 agent 替你作出的决定，不必从大段差异猜
